name: Generation 1: the first ten

sprites.name: Bulbasaur
sprites.note: Already in the library; only its settings changed, to match the research: skin and spots get a faint sheen (frog-like skin; no source calls it wet), the bulb is fleshy plant that lets a little light through, the mouth is wet, eyes and claws hard. Mark Redo to keep the old settings.

sprites.name: Ivysaur
sprites.note: Skin and its darker patches: smooth frog-like skin, faint sheen (patches are their own material, so they read as color, not bumps). Leaves: thin palm-like fronds that let light through. Bud: thick, fleshy, lets a little light through. Eyes, mouth, fangs and claws: hard and shiny.

sprites.name: Venusaur
sprites.note: Skin: bumpy hide, nearly matte. Petals: thick, matte Rafflesia-like petals that let a little light through; their pale spots are their own material. Trunk: dry palm bark. Yellow center: soft. Leaves: thin fronds, light through. Eyes, teeth and claws: hard and shiny.

sprites.name: Charmander
sprites.note: Skin and cream belly: smooth lizard skin, faint sheen. The tail flame glows (yellow core brightest, red tips least), and its glow flickers with the flame's drawings (the Pokédex: it burns brightly when healthy). Its Alternate 1 is gone: in the game data it was only a still pose.

sprites.name: Charmeleon
sprites.note: Skin and belly: harder scales, a little more shine than Charmander's. The flame glows brighter than Charmander's and flickers with its drawings. Its Alternate 1 is gone: its front was a still body, its back nearly a copy of Idle.

sprites.name: Charizard
sprites.note: Wing membranes (teal inside, orange outside): thin skin that lets light through. Skin and belly: faint sheen. The flame glows brightest of the three and flickers. Its Alternate 1 is gone: its back was a still pose while the front moved.

sprites.name: Squirtle
sprites.note: Shell: hard, springy turtle shell with a satin shine, not glassy (the Pokédex: fingers bounce off it); the belly plate a little less, the white rim the same. Skin: smooth, faint sheen.

sprites.name: Wartortle
sprites.note: Ears and tail: fur, fully fuzzy (the Pokédex calls them furry). Shell: worn, a little less shine than Squirtle's. Skin: smooth; the cheek streaks are their own material.

sprites.name: Blastoise
sprites.note: Cannons: shiny shell, not metal. No Pokédex entry or official art calls them metal; the art draws them white like the shell's rim. Say so if you want them metal. Shell, rim and belly plate: satin. Lower jaw: skin. Mouth: wet.

sprites.name: Caterpie
sprites.note: Body: soft green larval skin that lets light through like a leaf. The head's spots are its eyes (this sprite closes them); the ring spots along its sides are their own material. Red antenna: soft and moist. Nothing glows.

note: Bulbasaur to Caterpie, from the Black 2/White 2 sources. Each surface's material is set from the Pokédex and official art (the research is in the library's docs/materials.md). Motion is the game's own. Bulbasaur was already in the library; only its material settings changed.
